focus: D1 Correctness - phase 2/3 hook deadlines, runtime labels, CLI fallback and stale-daemon retry

findingDetails.title: Dead exported fallback-gate helper has no caller
findingDetails.evidence: Repo-wide symbol search over .skilled/.opencode/.pi (source and compiled output) finds only the definition and its runtime/dist twin; no import in the Claude hook, Pi hook, brief builder, plugin, or tests.
findingDetails.recommendation: Delete the export (and rebuild dist) or wire it to a live consumer with a test.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep -rn over .skilled/.opencode/.pi for the exported symbol; compared against all import sites of the fallback module

findingDetails.title: Operator budget above the shim kill ceiling is silently ineffective
findingDetails.evidence: The shim overrides SPECKIT_CLAUDE_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS only when unset, then kills the advisor child at CHILD_TIMEOUT_MS=2500 regardless; the advisor applies the operator value as its CLI budget via positiveIntFromEnv, so a value above 2500 is killed before it can emit the directives fallback and the turn returns {}.
findingDetails.recommendation: Clamp the pass-through to CHILD_TIMEOUT_MS minus margin, or document the 2500 ms ceiling beside the variable.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the shim spawn/limit block, advisor claudeHookTimeoutMs plumbing, and the fallback timer; nested deadline chain 2800/2500/2200 verified by hand

noveltyJustification: First pass over this surface; two P2 advisories, no P0/P1. Nested deadline ordering, stale-daemon retry condition and daemon error mapping, casual-prompt gate reconnect, runtime label propagation, Pi dual import paths, and both handler enrichment sites were verified end-to-end.
